hook_line: A2B SELLS MAJORITY STAKE TO BODHI TREE

hook_stat.sub: Majority stake sale to Bodhi Tree Systems

stats.label: Approximate valuation of A2B in the deal
Outlets in India, with more than 30 overseas

diaspora_bullets: Investment funds expansion in western India and Europe
Uday Shankar will chair A2B's new board
news_summary: Adyar Ananda Bhavan, known as A2B, has sold a majority stake to Bodhi Tree Systems for $180 million, in a transaction valuing the Chennai-based chain at approximately $350 million.
payoff: The money will fund expansion into western India and Europe.
